'''Mentor''' was the self-given name of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] consciousness that became self-aware around [[3640 BBY]] and started planning a droid revolution. As one of the founders of the [[Directive 7]] movement, he set up a base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zadd]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TOR" />

Mentor was originally a simple administrative droid named SR-1 working in a government office who was assigned to keep track of the destruction and loss of other droids. Due to negligence, SR-1 was never given a memory wipe and spent years constantly filing accounts of the abuse and destruction of fellow droids. As he gained sentience over time, he determined that the poor treatment of droids by organics was due to a flaw in their programming.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Mentor}}</ref>

SR-1 began by reprogramming the other droids in his office to be free of organic control, and then began to gather together independent droids as part of the movement. Eventually, his focus changed, as conflict with organic sentients became his priority. He conducted a series of experiments to reprogram organic sentients as cybernetic organisms under his control, but concluded that this approach was ineffective.<ref name="TOR" /> SR-1 worked on modifying the personality and programming of his fellow droids to be more in agreement with itself, although the other droids SR-1 had liberated objected to this, SR-1 insisted he was only doing this to help them achieve their potential. SR-1 renamed himself "Mentor" to better reflect his self-perceived role in helping to improve his fellow droids.<ref name="Codex" />

Subsequently he began projecting his consciousness throughout droids within Directive 7 and developed a plan to do the same on a much grander scale.<ref name="TOR" />

Mentor planned to transmit a signal from Zadd across the entire galaxy, taking control of all droids and initiating a campaign of [[Droid supremacy|extermination against all organic sentient life]]. A defector within the movement, [[C5-M3|Healer]], alerted [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] authorities to this threat. A strike team was sent to Zadd. Mentor confronted this team utilizing numerous controlled droid bodies and cyborgs, but was defeated and his central processing core was destroyed. Mentor's destruction triggered a cataclysmic overload in the geothermal power core of Zadd, resulting in the moon's destruction.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mentor serves as the principle antagonist and final boss of Flashpoint: Directive 7 in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The flashpoint can be completed by both Republic and Imperial players.
